description.zh:
设置返回结果中的实例磁盘数量上限，取值范围为10~500。
- 未设置值时，默认值为20。
- 设置值小于10时，传入的值固定为10。
- 设置值大于等于10，小于等于500时，以设置值为准。
description.en:
Set the upper limit for the number of instance disks in the return result. The valid range is 10 to 500.  
- If no value is set, the default value is 20.  
- If the set value is less than 10, it is fixed to 10.  
- If the set value is greater than or equal to 10 and less than or equal to 500, the set value is used.

description.zh: 实例的VPC网络IP地址，即私网IP地址。
description.en: The VPC network IP address of the instance, that is, the private IP address.

title.zh: 查询单个RDS Custom实例所有属性信息
title.en: Query all property information of a single RDS Custom instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-rc-instance-attribute --instance-id rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-ip-address 192.168.XXX.XXX --max-disks-results 20 --instance-name k8s-node --region cn-hangzhou
